policyDefinitions.target: A contiguous textual label organizing substantive document content or outline.
policyDefinitions.boundary: complete contiguous label, meaningful numbering/punctuation included, surrounding whitespace excluded, source-local UTF-16 half-open offsets
ambiguous: The human hierarchy guideline says title/running-header/TOC/appendix/table-only text are context but does not itself redefine heading labels.
Legal marker inclusion is evidenced by the reviewed legal reference, not a global regex rule.
Per-document approved projections remain instance evidence and are not copied into the runtime prompt.

currentR1PromptAudit.rule: every structurally real document heading or structural label
currentR1PromptAudit.reason: requests labels outside the projected substantive-heading target

currentR1PromptAudit.rule: zero, one, or many elements per occurrence
formatting, numbering, layout are evidence, not rules
currentR1PromptAudit.reason: does not make a heuristic gate
does not say complete label versus fragment

currentR1PromptAudit.rule: extract navigation, TOC, front matter too; projection later
currentR1PromptAudit.reason: explicitly broadens the model target beyond projected content headings

hypothesis.note: The broad prompt is a real ontology defect, but the frozen extras are overwhelmingly fragmented prose/list content rather than legitimate excluded headings.
